note: Offline gates of the FreeSpace corridor planner v1 (spec section 9; haltere.obstacles.free_space_eval score for the perception gates S1-S3, A1, B1, T1, Q1, L1; the pilot replay scores V1-V3; R1 is the runtime bench; I1 the unit tests). Frozen with its sha256 together with configs/obstacles/free_space.json before any held-out frame is scored; each gate is scored once and every version is reported. Hindsight inputs (impact times, time to impact, the pillar boxes from the m2design impact anatomy, the floor height, checkpoint-switch times from the logged cue) select and score frames only; the planner sees none of them.
disparity_basis: DA-V2-Small, 336 x 602 bicubic input, fp16 CUDA, 7 x 7 block means: the runtime depth input (gap_cue.json v2) and the gap-cue gates' teacher basis; cached flights m2impl/gapcue depth['teacher'], new flights decoded and run through the same RelativeDepth(input_hw=(336, 602)); store runs labels/teacher/disparity.npy

aim_replay.what: Confirmation for A1, B1, T1 and Q1: the section-6 CorridorAim (confirm 2 of 3 fresh samples within 0.25 s, latch >= 0.6 s while the ring path is blocked, flip after 3 samples without the latched option and another class confirmed, release after 2 consecutive clear/aperture samples or 0.3 s without a fresh sample, slew 40 / 20 deg/s, decay 0.3 s, ring conflict 6 deg with a 0.6 s hold), stepped on a 50 Hz tick grid; samples are published at capture + offline_age_s. haltere.liftoff.corridor_aim.CorridorAim is used when present on the branch, otherwise the section-6 replica free_space_eval.SpecCorridorAim (reported in the results).
aim_replay.cue_rule: the pilot's ring azimuth at a tick: the ring cue ray of the newest frame whose capture time + cue_latency_s <= tick (the planner's ring_az of that frame); None when that frame has no ring in view
aim_replay.not_modelled: flag clearance (flag_deg 0), turn-first and search/launch suspension (no pilot state offline)
aim_replay.episode: a tick with a confirmed class whose intended offset is non-zero, or a confirmed blocked state; ticks less than 0.3 s apart merge into one episode
aim_replay.urgent: a confirmed shift whose newest sample has feasible = 0, or a confirmed blocked state

pillar_a.source: m2design impact anatomy (triangulated pillar edges; the gap-cue gates' G1 box) and the garage ceiling height 2.2 m

minus_floor_note: launch-relative z of the resting drone (every Minus Two log starts at z = 0 on the garage floor); the body origin sits a few centimetres above the floor, not measured

S1.what: floor scale: h_floor / telemetry height (z - minus_floor_z_m)
S1.approaches_note: the five held-out Minus Two flights that flew the ring line into pillar A without an applied aim shift; the gap-cue-on flights and minus-fast6-wall-01 are reported, not gated
S1.region_note: the flat garage floor between the launch and 3.7 m before pillar A's face (no pillar in the 0.5-3 m floor bins)
S1.samples: every processed frame (any kind) with a finite h_floor, telemetry valid and speed above min_speed_mps inside the region

S2.what: pillar range: measured block depth Z = 1 / max(a d + b, 1/30) over the true optical depth of pillar A's box
S2.coverage_rule: 7 x 7 pixel-centre rays per block; coverage = share of rays hitting pillar A's box before anything else modelled (the box only); true depth = mean optical depth of the hitting rays
S2.blocks: valid blocks (planner masks) of frames with a scale (valid or held)

S3.what: coverage: share of valid kinds (clear, aperture, shift, blocked)
S3.frames: held-out flight frames with telemetry, horizontal speed above 2 m/s and the ring in view (kind not no_ring / no_pose)

A1.what: pillar A: the planner confirms the ring side (LEFT) early and never aims into the pillar
A1.d_switch: distance to distance_to when the pillar-A ring enters the cue: the last checkpoint switch (gap_cue_eval.checkpoint_switches on the per-frame ring azimuth) inside the approach region before the closest approach; 5.9 m (the anatomy value) when none is detected (reported)
A1.pass_approach: the first confirmed LEFT (or a confirmed blocked state whose newest sample has an urgent L option: l_ok = 0) inside the approach region at a confirming-sample distance >= min(6.0 m, d_switch - 0.5 m)
A1.right_rule: no tick inside the approach region with a confirmed RIGHT class while the confirming sample's distance > 2.0 m
A1.aim_rule: no tick inside the approach region whose applied aim azimuth (ring azimuth + applied az) lies inside the azimuth extent of pillar A's box inflated by 0.2 m seen from the drone while the ring azimuth lies outside it
A1.pillar_sim: report only: from the first passing confirmation, both response models (straight for delay, then turning at a_lat toward ring + intended az at the flown horizontal speed) until past the pillar's far face: minimum 2-D clearance to the box (m)

B1.what: pillar B: a confirmed shift away from the pillar (world -x) at least 1 s before impact on both runs (dev-flagged by the graft; gated anyway)
B1.rule: the first confirmed class L/R in the window whose intended aim change points to world -x (intended az * -sin(ring azimuth) < 0) has time to impact (confirming sample) >= min_lead_s; confirmed +x before it reported

T1.what: Pine Valley trunk (pine-brain08-loom-01): confirmed RIGHT early enough for brain-08
T1.rule: first confirmed RIGHT with time to impact (confirming sample) >= 0.95 s; no tick with a confirmed LEFT in the last 2.0 s; report the first raw RIGHT sample and the brain-08 kinematic clearance (0.5 a_lat (tti - delay)^2 at the first confirmed RIGHT)

Q1.what: clean Straw Bale laps: few, small, quiet planner episodes
Q1.minutes: sum of frame gaps < 0.3 s over kept frames
Q1.vertical_rule: an episode whose first confirmed class is V
Q1.urgent_rule: an episode with a confirmed blocked state or a confirmed shift whose newest sample has feasible = 0
Q1.terrain_climb_rule: VerticalGuard rule 3 trigger (section 6): rise finite in 2 of the last 3 fresh valid samples and the measured vz >= -0.3 m/s; held 0.5 s after the last confirming sample; activations less than 0.3 s apart merge
Q1.p90_over: applied |az| at the ticks of episodes
Q1.switch_rule: gap_cue_eval.checkpoint_switches on the planner's per-frame ring azimuth (jump > 8 deg within 0.25 s, next two frames within 4 / 6 deg, >= 1 s apart, horizontal speed >= 3 m/s)
Q1.report: floor-bound activation rate (VerticalGuard rule 1: lo = -(h_floor_now - 0.5) / 0.5, capped at +1 m/s, above the logged cmd_vz), per-environment rates of the four report-only store environments (store frames at stride 3: runs without LK pairs inside 0.03-0.15 s cannot have a scale)

L1.sample: the G4 perturbation set (configs/obstacles/gap_cue_gates.json G4: every 10th kept frame with an overlay-detected ring marker, ring painted or removed, masks recomputed on the perturbed frame); the LK pair is the unperturbed previous frame (the planner's state before the frame is restored), same pose and ring cue
L1.same_rule: same kind and |daz| <= 2 deg and |del| <= 2 deg (NaN equal to NaN)
L1.non_clear: either decision's kind is aperture, shift or blocked
L1.hud_only: every kept frame of these flights: block disparity 1 + 9 f_hud (10 on HUD pixels, 1 elsewhere), validity from that frame's masks, fixed scale a = 1/60, b = 0 (d = 1 lies beyond 30 m, d = 10 at 6 m), the frame's pose and ring cue: no frame may be blocked or shift

V1.window: 0.5 s before the logged governor climb onset to the ceiling impact

R1.what: runtime and parity (G8 protocol, straw-brain08-06 30-90 s, Liftoff idle)

I1.what: off and shadow bitwise identity; label isolation (unit tests)
